title: Satisfying extension preserves compatibility
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates and let $ho$ be a coordinate restriction compatible with $T$, meaning that some completion of its free coordinates makes $T$ evaluate to $-1$. Then the restriction obtained by fixing the coordinates at the free literal positions to the values prescribed by the satisfying assignment of $T$ is also compatible with $T$.
hypotheses_covered: The restriction is compatible with the term
